content.rendered:
“But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves…”
(Matthew 14: 24)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

At the middle of the sea, the ship in which Jesus’ disciples travelled was tossed with waves. The waves didn’t arise at the beginning of their journey; it arose in the middle of the sea. The waves came to stop them from completing their journey. The waves wanted them to stop in the middle.

Eventually, despite the waves, the ship continued to sail. The waves couldn’t stop the ship in the middle of the sea. The waves couldn’t truncate the journey of the ship. Jesus’ disciples had a purpose for being in the ship, they needed to arrive at the other side of the sea, and the waves did not stop them. They didn’t stop middle of the sea.

Friend, hear God’s word of grace: you will not stop in the middle. Your life will not be cut short in the middle. The destiny of your family will not stop on the way. Your greatness will not stop in the middle; your testimony will not stop on the way; your marriage, finances, career, business, ministry, academics, etc will not be halted by satanic forces. Your progress will not be cut short. No power of hell will truncate your movement.

Jesus’ disciples began a journey and completed their journey. God says, you will complete every journey you started; you will complete every project you began; you shall achieve everything you set out to achieve; you won’t be counted among those whose journeys ended without results. Whatsoever your hands have begun, God will give you grace to complete it.

Jesus was involved in the journey of His disciples. He sent them to the other side of the sea, and He wasn’t about to watch them sink in the sea because of waves. If Jehovah is truly involved in your life, then no demon of hell can stop you in the middle of your journey.

Pray With Me: Lord, I will not stop on the way, in Jesus’ name!
